description: This file defines functions and data structures for handling hexadecimal conversion, such as converting hex characters to byte values, processing pairs of hex digits, and converting hex strings to byte arrays.

methods.name: unsigned int hexval(unsigned char c)
methods.description: Returns the numerical value of a hexadecimal character using a lookup table.

methods.name: int hex2chr(const char * s)
methods.description: Converts two hexadecimal characters into a single byte, returning a negative value on error.

methods.name: hex_to_bytes
methods.description: Converts a hex string into its binary representation by processing pairs of hex digits.

ctags.name: hexval
ctags.pattern: /^static inline unsigned int hexval(unsigned char c)$/
